text_blocks.snippet: Dengue virus infection can cause a range of symptoms, from mild to severe. Most cases are mild, with symptoms including fever, headache (often behind the eyes), joint and muscle pain, nausea, and a rash. However, some individuals can develop severe dengue, characterized by severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, fluid accumulation, bleeding, and organ impairment.
